question: In a video demonstrating the preparation of a salad, two main ingredients are prominently featured with on-screen text overlays. Begin by identifying these two ingredients from the video. Next, using the USDA FoodData Central database (specifically the SR Legacy data), look up the protein content per 100g for the identified legume (look for the entry matching 'Chickpeas... canned, drained solids') and the identified cheese (look for the entry matching 'Cheese, feta'). Finally, calculate the absolute difference between their protein contents and round the result to the nearest whole number.
